    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">参数校验类异常（Argument Exception）【C# Exception 详解系列一】</span>

            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        本文主要介绍参数校验类异常（Argument Exception），主要包括四种：ArgumentNullException、ArgumentException、ArgumentOutOfRangeException、DuplicateWaitObjectException。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2>〇、前言</h2>
<p>前文已经列举了全部有哪些常见的异常类型，本文就开始介绍下各个类别的异常特点。</p>
<p>本文主要介绍参数校验类异常（Argument Exception），主要包括四种：<strong>ArgumentNullException、ArgumentException、ArgumentOutOfRangeException、DuplicateWaitObjectException</strong>。</p>
<p>点击链接可以查看本系列文章：<span style="font-size: 12px"><em><a title="https://www.cnblogs.com/hnzhengfy/category/2537680.html" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/hnzhengfy/category/2537680.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">C# Exception 详解系列</a>。</em></span></p>
<h2>一、参数校验类异常总览</h2>
<pre class="language-javascript highlighter-hljs"><code>Exception
 └─ SystemException
      └─ ArgumentException                 ← 基类，带 ParamName
           ├─ ArgumentNullException        ← 参数为 null
           ├─ ArgumentOutOfRangeException  ← 参数值越界（带 ActualValue）
           └─ DuplicateWaitObjectException ← 同步对象数组中有重复项</code></pre>
<p>它们共同的关键特征：<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)">都携带 ParamName</span>（由 ArgumentException 提供），这样调用方 catch 后能精确知道是哪个参数出了问题，日志、监控、API 错误响应都能直接用上这个字段</strong>。这也是"参数校验异常"和 InvalidOperationException（对象状态不对，不是调用方传错）最本质的区别。</p>
<p><strong>怎么选择？</strong></p>
<pre class="language-javascript highlighter-hljs"><code>参数是引用类型且为 null？           → ArgumentNullException
参数非 null，但字符串内容不合法？    → ArgumentException（或 ThrowIfNullOrEmpty / ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace）
参数是数值/枚举/索引/长度越界？      → ArgumentOutOfRangeException
参数是同步句柄数组且有重复？         → DuplicateWaitObjectException（几乎不用自己抛）
参数本身合法，但当前对象状态不允许？   → InvalidOperationException（不属于本类，别用错）</code></pre>
<h2>二、各个异常简介与简单示例</h2>
<h3>2.1 ArgumentException</h3>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>语义：参数不为 null，但值本身在语义上不成立——格式错、含非法字符、组合矛盾、不在允许的枚举集合内。</strong></span></p>
<p>关键成员：<strong>ParamName</strong>、可自定义 Message、<strong>支持 InnerException（适合包装解析失败的原生异常）</strong>。</p>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>public void SetOutputPath(string path)
{
    ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(path);
    if (path.IndexOfAny(Path.GetInvalidPathChars()) &gt;= 0)
        throw new ArgumentException("路径不能包含通配符或非法字符", nameof(path));
    if (Path.IsPathRooted(path) == false)
        throw new ArgumentException("必须是绝对路径", nameof(path));
}
// 多个参数之间存在逻辑矛盾：把"哪个参数有问题"说清楚
public void Configure(TimeSpan timeout, int retryCount)
{
    if (retryCount &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; timeout == TimeSpan.Zero)
        throw new ArgumentException("启用重试时超时时间不能为零", nameof(timeout));
}
// 包装下层异常，保留根因
public Guid ParseId(string id)
{
    ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrEmpty(id);
    try { return Guid.Parse(id); }
    catch (FormatException ex)
    {
        throw new ArgumentException($"'{id}' 不是有效的 GUID", nameof(id), ex);
    }
}</code></pre>
<p>.NET 7/8+ 简化写法：</p>
<table style="width: 94.0673%">
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="width: 37.3508%">方法</th>
<th style="width: 6.87891%">版本</th>
<th style="width: 14.3263%">触发条件</th>
<th style="width: 41.444%">抛出</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="width: 37.3508%"><code>ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrEmpty(s)</code></td>
<td style="width: 6.87891%">.NET 7+</td>
<td style="width: 14.3263%"><code>null</code> 或 <code>""</code></td>
<td style="width: 41.444%">null→<code>ArgumentNullException</code>，空→<code>ArgumentException</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 37.3508%"><code>ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(s)</code></td>
<td style="width: 6.87891%">.NET 8+</td>
<td style="width: 14.3263%"><code>null</code>/<code>""</code>/全空白</td>
<td style="width: 41.444%">同上</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 37.3508%"><code>ArgumentException.ThrowIfEqual / ThrowIfNotEqual</code></td>
<td style="width: 6.87891%">.NET 8+</td>
<td style="width: 14.3263%">值相等性不符</td>
<td style="width: 41.444%"><code>ArgumentException</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>public void Rename(string name)
{
    ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(name); // 一条顶三条
}</code></pre>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>适用场景：正则/路径/邮箱/文件名合法性、枚举 IsDefined 校验、连接字符串关键字、集合中不允许出现特定元素、多参数互斥约束。</strong></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>2.2 ArgumentNullException</h3>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>语义：方法契约要求"必填"的引用参数传入了 null。这是调用方的 bug，不是"没找到数据"。</strong></span></p>
<p>关键成员：<code class="qk-md-code">ParamName</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">；消息固定为&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i31.39f229880nF1uR">“Value cannot be null. (Parameter 'x')”</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></p>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>// 传统写法（所有框架版本可用）
public void Save(string fileName, Stream content)
{
    if (fileName == null)
        throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(fileName));

    if (content == null)
        throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(content), "必须提供可写的内容流");
}
// .NET 6+ 推荐写法：不需要 nameof，靠 [CallerArgumentExpression] 自动捕获
public void Save(string fileName, Stream content)
{
    ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(fileName);
    ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(content);
}</code></pre>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i36.39f229880nF1uR">适用场景</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span></div>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">公共 API / 构造函数的依赖注入参数（</span><code class="qk-md-code">IService</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">ILogger</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、委托回调）。</span></strong></span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">工具方法的核心入参（路径、SQL、表达式树、集合）。</span></strong></span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">不适用</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：可选参数（给默认值）、"查不到"的情况（应返回 null /&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">TryXxx</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;/ 抛&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">KeyNotFoundException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">）。</span></li>
</ul>
<p>两个需要特别注意的点：</p>
<p>① <code class="qk-md-code"><strong>ThrowIfNull</strong></code><strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;不能直接用于&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Nullable&lt;T&gt;</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">（会装箱且语义奇怪），值类型判空请用手动判断或&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">if (value is null)</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;模式；</span></strong></p>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">②&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">.NET 7</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;起才有&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">void*</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;指针重载，非托管互操作场景要注意目标框架。</span></p>
<p>ArgumentNullException 可以拦截 null，但是不会拦截 ""。ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull("") 会直接放行 ""（等价于 string.Empty）是一个真实的、非 null 的字符串对象实例，它在堆上有地址、有 Length 属性（值为 0）。ThrowIfNull 内部只做一件事：if (arg is null) throw ...，所以空字符串对它来说完全合法，检查会静默通过。</p>
<table style="width: 91.6622%">
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="width: 29.3926%">写法</th>
<th style="width: 23.3189%"><code>null</code></th>
<th style="width: 20.0651%"><code>""</code></th>
<th style="width: 20.0651%"><code>"   "</code></th>
<th style="width: 7.15835%"><code>"abc"</code></th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tr>
<td style="width: 29.3926%"><code>ThrowIfNull(s)</code></td>
<td style="width: 23.3189%">❌ 抛</td>
<td style="width: 20.0651%">✅ 过</td>
<td style="width: 20.0651%">✅ 过</td>
<td style="width: 7.15835%">✅ 过</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 29.3926%"><code>ThrowIfNullOrEmpty(s)</code> (.NET 7+)</td>
<td style="width: 23.3189%">❌ 抛 ArgumentNullException</td>
<td style="width: 20.0651%">❌ 抛 ArgumentException</td>
<td style="width: 20.0651%">✅ 过</td>
<td style="width: 7.15835%">✅ 过</td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td style="width: 23.3189%">❌ 抛 ANE</td>
<td style="width: 20.0651%">❌ 抛 AE</td>
<td style="width: 20.0651%">❌ 抛 ArgumentException</td>
<td style="width: 7.15835%">✅ 过</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>2.3 ArgumentOutOfRangeException</h3>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i40.39f229880nF1uR"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i41.39f229880nF1uR">语义</span></span><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i38.39f229880nF1uR">：参数是</span><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">数值型或有序量</span></span></strong></span><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>，落在方法承诺的有效区间之外。</strong></span>它是&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ArgumentException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;的子类，因此 catch&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ArgumentException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;也能接住它。</span></div>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">关键成员</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span><code class="qk-md-code">ActualValue</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">（把调用方传入的真实值带上，排查线上问题极其有用）、</span><code class="qk-md-code">ParamName</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></p>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>// 传统三参构造：paramName, actualValue, message
public byte[] ReadChunk(int count)
{
    if (count &lt;= 0)
        throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(count), count, "必须大于 0");
}
// 索引/容量类：把越界值和上限都写进消息，是 BCL 的一贯风格
public T At&lt;T&gt;(IList&lt;T&gt; list, int index)
{
    ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(list);
    if ((uint)index &gt;= (uint)list.Count)
        throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(index), index,
            $"索引必须在 [0, {list.Count}) 范围内");
}</code></pre>
<p>.NET 8+ 的数值校验全家桶（推荐优先用）：</p>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(count);        // &lt; 0
ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfZero(count);            // == 0
ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(count);  // &lt;= 0
ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfGreaterThan(count, 100);// &gt; 100
ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThan(count, 1);     // &lt; 1
ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfEqual(flag, 0);         // == 0</code></pre>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong>适用场景：集合索引与容量、分页 pageSize/pageIndex、超时时间、重试次数、端口号、缓冲区大小、枚举转整型后的范围、日期区间（start &gt; end）、<code>Enum.ToObject</code> 前的校验。</strong></span></p>
<p>经验：“小于等于零”比“小于零”更常用。BCL 里表示数量、长度的参数几乎都要求 &gt; 0，所以 <code>ThrowIfNegativeOrZero </code>出场率远高于 <code>ThrowIfNegative</code>。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>2.4 DuplicateWaitObjectException</h3>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i51.39f229880nF1uR">语义</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：一个</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">同步对象（WaitHandle）数组里出现了重复项</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">，导致等待语义不明确（同一个内核句柄被等待两次，唤醒计数无法确定）。</span></span></div>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">继承链：</span><code class="qk-md-code">ArgumentException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;→ 所以它也有&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ParamName</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">HRESULT：</span><code class="qk-md-code">COR_E_DUPLICATEWAITOBJECT (0x80131529)</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">谁在抛</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：几乎全是运行时自己在抛 ——&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">WaitHandle.WaitAll</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">WaitHandle.WaitAny</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;发现数组中有重复 OS 句柄时；某些&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i50.39f229880nF1uR">Monitor</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">/线程原语实现路径也会产生。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">你几乎不需要手动抛它</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">。它属于"框架级契约异常"，就像&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">IndexOutOfRangeException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;一样，是平台替你表达的约束。</span></li>
</ul>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">唯一可能自己抛的场景：</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">自己写的并发原语</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">（比如：封装一个&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">WaitAnyEx</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、自定义 Barrier、基于句柄池的多路复用器），并且 API 也接受 </span><code class="qk-md-code">WaitHandle[]</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;或类似的"对象集合"参数，此时为了与 BCL 行为一致，可以抛它：</span></div>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>public static int WaitAnyEx(WaitHandle[] handles, TimeSpan timeout)
{
    ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(handles);
    if (handles.Length == 0)
        throw new ArgumentException("等待数组不能为空", nameof(handles));
    // 用引用相等判断重复（与 WaitHandle 内部逻辑一致）
    for (int i = 0; i &lt; handles.Length; i++)
        for (int j = i + 1; j &lt; handles.Length; j++)
            if (ReferenceEquals(handles[i], handles[j]))
                throw new DuplicateWaitObjectException(nameof(handles));
    return WaitHandle.WaitAny(handles, timeout);
}</code></pre>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i54.39f229880nF1uR">调用方该怎么处理</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：一般</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">不该 catch 后重试</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">（重试结果一样），应当记录日志并修复传入的数组来源；如果代码要兼容旧框架/UWP，直接 catch&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ArgumentException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;更安全（该异常在某些 SKU 中未被导出）。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>三、为什么推荐优先用 ThrowIf 系列（不只是少打字）</h2>
<h3>3.1 自动带参数名，消灭 nameof 抄错</h3>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>// 这种 bug 真实存在：检查的是 a，写的却是 nameof(b)
if (a == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(b)); // 编译器不报错！

ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(a); // 通过 [CallerArgumentExpression("argument")] 自动填入 "a"</code></pre>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>3.2 性能更好</h3>
<p><strong><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i61.39f229880nF1uR">这些方法是&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">[DoesNotReturn]</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;+ 内联友好的静态 helper，JIT 能识别并做优化，且避免了在非异常路径上构造异常对象的开销（异常对象只在真的失败时才创建）。</span></strong></p>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">.NET 分析器&nbsp;</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">CA1512</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;会直接把&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">if (...) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(...)</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;标黄，提示替换成对应的&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ThrowIfXxx</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><span style="font-size: 16px">3.3 版本对照速查</span></h3>
<table style="width: 86.4244%">
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="width: 21.2553%">需求</th>
<th style="width: 45.5064%">老写法</th>
<th style="width: 33.3809%">最低版本</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="width: 21.2553%"><strong>非 null</strong></td>
<td style="width: 45.5064%"><code>if (x==null) throw ...</code></td>
<td style="width: 33.3809%">.NET 6 <code>ThrowIfNull</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 21.2553%"><strong>非空字符串</strong></td>
<td style="width: 45.5064%"><code>if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(s)) throw ...</code></td>
<td style="width: 33.3809%">.NET 7 <code>ThrowIfNullOrEmpty</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 21.2553%"><strong>非空白字符串</strong></td>
<td style="width: 45.5064%"><code>if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s)) throw ...</code></td>
<td style="width: 33.3809%">.NET 8 <code>ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 21.2553%"><strong>数值范围</strong></td>
<td style="width: 45.5064%"><code>if (n &lt;= 0) throw ...</code></td>
<td style="width: 33.3809%">.NET 8 <code>ThrowIfNegativeOrZero</code> 等</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="width: 21.2553%"><strong>目标框架低于上述版本</strong></td>
<td style="width: 45.5064%">自己封一层 helper（见下）</td>
<td style="width: 33.3809%">任意</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i65.39f229880nF1uR">低版本框架的自救方案</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">（照抄 BCL 思路，几十行搞定）：</span></p>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>internal static class Guard
{
    public static void ThrowIfNull([NotNull] object? arg,
        [CallerArgumentExpression(nameof(arg))] string? name = null)
    {
        if (arg is null) throw new ArgumentNullException(name);
    }
    public static void ThrowIfNullOrEmpty(string? arg,
        [CallerArgumentExpression(nameof(arg))] string? name = null)
    {
        if (arg is null) throw new ArgumentNullException(name);
        if (arg.Length == 0) throw new ArgumentException("值不能为空字符串", name);
    }
    public static void ThrowIfOutOfRange&lt;T&gt;(T value, T min, T max,
        [CallerArgumentExpression(nameof(value))] string? name = null) where T : IComparable&lt;T&gt;
    {
        if (value.CompareTo(min) &lt; 0 || value.CompareTo(max) &gt; 0)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(name, value, $"必须在 [{min}, {max}] 内");
    }
}</code></pre>
<p>注意：[CallerArgumentExpression] 只能修饰带默认值的 string 可选参数，且属性里的名字要和目标形参严格一致，否则静默失效。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>四、最佳实践清单和完整示例</h2>
<p>以下是几个简单的场景和处理方法推荐。</p>
<ul>
<li><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i69.39f229880nF1uR">只在校验边界抛</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：公共 API、构造函数、受保护的虚方法入口。私有方法内部多用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Debug.Assert</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">；性能敏感的 hot path 上别做冗余校验（能被 JIT 内联消除的简单 null check 除外）。</span></li>
<li><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">顺序固定</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：先 null，再内容/格式，最后范围与跨参数约束。这样失败消息永远指向"最靠前的那个错误"，稳定可预期。</span></li>
<li><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">永远用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">nameof</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;或 ThrowIf 自动捕获</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">，绝不手写字符串&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">"path"</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。重构改名时前者会编译报错，后者不会。</span></li>
<li><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">别手动抛&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">NullReferenceException</code></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">。它是运行时解引用 null 时的产物；参数为 null 属于"调用方违约"，语义上必须是&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ArgumentNullException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。二者在监控告警、调试器行为、Roslyn 分析上都不同。同理也别用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">Exception</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">、</span><code class="qk-md-code">ApplicationException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;做参数校验。</span></li>
<li><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">区分"参数错"和"状态错"</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：文件路径合法但文件不存在 → 抛&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">FileNotFoundException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">；流已关闭还去读 →&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ObjectDisposedException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">；迭代器已启动后修改集合 →&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">InvalidOperationException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">。这些都不属于本节的 Argument 家族。</span></li>
<li><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">DTO/接口边界用验证框架，领域层用异常</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：ASP.NET Core 入参建议走 FluentValidation / 数据注解（返回 400），服务层内部再用 Argument 异常（返回 500 或统一错误码）。两者混用会让前端拿到堆栈而不是字段级错误。</span></li>
<li><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">catch 时尽量按子类细分</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span></li>
</ul>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>try { svc.Do(x, n); }
catch (ArgumentNullException e)   when (e.ParamName == nameof(x))  { /* 必传缺失 */ }
catch (ArgumentOutOfRangeException e) { /* 用 e.ActualValue 做降级 */ }
catch (ArgumentException)         { /* 其他参数问题 */ }</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">枚举与泛型</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span><code class="qk-md-code">Enum.IsDefined</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;校验非法整型 →&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ArgumentException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">；泛型&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">where T : class</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;时用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ThrowIfNull</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，无约束泛型则手动判空并给出明确的参数名。</span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>把以上场景实践串起来的简单示例：</strong></p>
<pre class="language-csharp highlighter-hljs"><code>public sealed class LogRotator
{
    private readonly string _dir;
    private readonly int _maxFiles;
    private readonly long _maxBytes;

    public LogRotator(string directory, int maxFiles, long maxBytesPerFile)
    {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(directory);
        if (directory.IndexOfAny(Path.GetInvalidPathChars()) &gt;= 0)
            throw new ArgumentException("目录名包含非法字符", nameof(directory));
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(maxFiles);
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(maxBytesPerFile);
        _dir = Path.GetFullPath(directory);
        _maxFiles = maxFiles;
        _maxBytes = maxBytesPerFile;
    }

    public void Rotate(ICollection&lt;string&gt; files, int startIndex, int count)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(files);
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(count);
        ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(startIndex);
        if (startIndex + count &gt; files.Count)
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(count), count,
                $"从 {startIndex} 开始的 {count} 个元素超出集合大小 {files.Count}");
        var handleArray = files.Select(f =&gt; new ManualResetEvent(false)).ToArray();
        // 这里如果数组里有重复句柄，WaitAny 会自己抛 DuplicateWaitObjectException
        // —— 我们不用、也不应该替它抛
    }
}</code></pre>
<h2>五、小小的总结</h2>
<p><code class="qk-md-code" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i77.39f229880nF1uR">ArgumentNullException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;管"有没有传"，</span><code class="qk-md-code">ArgumentException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;管"传得对不对"，</span><code class="qk-md-code">ArgumentOutOfRangeException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;管"传得超没超界"，</span><code class="qk-md-code">DuplicateWaitObjectException</code><span class="qk-md-text complete"> 是运行时替同步原语管的，基本不用碰。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(251, 238, 184, 1)"><span class="qk-md-text complete">能升级到高版本框架就一律用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">ThrowIfXxx</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;系列，既短、又快、还不会把参数名写错。</span></span></strong></p>

</div>
